children.name: Article Eyebrow
children.text: INSTALL

children.name: Article Title
children.text: Air-gapped and private-registry installation

children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Mirror every required artifact and trust root, then install and upgrade without hidden public-network dependencies.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: An offline install is accepted only when rendered manifests contain no public endpoint or mutable tag.

children.name: Section Title 1
children.text: Build the release bundle

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Inventory, verify, and mirror all artifacts by digest before entering the restricted environment.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Include chart, images, CRDs, modules, signatures, SBOMs, and checksums.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Mirror verified artifacts by digest to approved internal registries.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Package values, public keys, CA certificates, notes, and rollback bundle.

children.name: Section Title 2
children.text: Prepare the restricted cluster

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Provide registry trust, pull credentials, DNS, proxy rules, storage, edge, identity, database, backups, and observability locally.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Configure registry mirrors, imagePullSecrets, private CA, and no-proxy.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Rewrite references to internal endpoints without changing digests.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Pre-provision every dependency that would otherwise require public egress.

children.name: Section Title 2
children.text: Disable usage telemetry

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: New installs report to telemetry.gameplane.net; an empty endpoint uses it too. Turn it off at install so offline clusters never retry.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Set api.telemetry.enabled=false in values-offline.yaml: no notice, switches unavailable.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Or enable the bundled receiver (api.telemetry.receiver.enabled=true) to keep figures in-cluster.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Or point api.telemetry.endpoint at an internal receiver.

children.name: Section Title 3
children.text: Prove isolation

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Render and scan offline, then test install, module sync, GameServer creation, backup, upgrade, and rollback with egress denied.

children.name: Quick Reference Label
children.text: OFFLINE ACCEPTANCE

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Mirror chart + images + modules + signatures + SBOMs by digest

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Render offline; reject public hosts and mutable tags

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Test install, server, backup, upgrade, rollback with egress blocked
